_source: Hand-authored, canonical (docs/tech-plan/Character-Secrets.md). Owner 2026-11-19: 'Start with the development of the Powder Faction.' [MM-story_mwohmiyq_2u]

air.why: She trades powder for Sora Ito's engine parts.

lines.start: Count your powder, Commander. Nobody else will.
lines.win: Fewer shells spent than I guessed. Good.
lines.lose: Losses: everything. I'll write it down.

secrets.text: She wants Heartwood Amber. It seals powder casks against the damp.
secrets.line: Bring me amber. Damp powder kills more than bullets.

secrets.text: She hates the Chancellor's auditors, who count her shells and never the dead.
secrets.line: The auditors count shells. Somebody should count the dead.

secrets.text: She'll open her spare stores to anyone who keeps them full.
secrets.line: Fill my stores and I'll pay you for the trouble.

mission.task: Deliver 20 Loam Grain to the Verdance stores.

secrets.text: She can smell a bad batch of powder before the cask is opened, and a lie before it is spoken.
secrets.line: Something smells wrong today. Powder, or people.

secrets.text: She loves Mechanic Sora Ito of the Air, an enemy. They trade parts, letters, and worse.
secrets.line: There's a mechanic on the other side. Don't tell anyone.

secrets.text: Her brother died to a shell she signed out herself.
secrets.line: I signed for the shell that killed my brother.

secrets.text: She wants to walk away from the war with a balanced ledger and a quiet conscience.
secrets.line: One day the books balance, and I walk away.

secrets.text: Under the old supply depot she buried a crate of pre-war wine, and the deed to a farm.
secrets.line: There's a crate under the old depot. It's mine.

mission.task: Recover her crate from the old depot on Verdance map 4.

secrets.text: Her tally pencil never runs short. The numbers finish themselves while she sleeps.
secrets.line: My pencil keeps counting when I don't. Don't laugh.

mission.task: Bring her a Rootsong Seed so the pencil can count the harvest.

water.why: He owes Finn Saltmoor a bar tab and his life.

lines.start: Someone's knocking, lads. Let's be rude about it!
lines.win: Ha! Somebody buy the Commander a drink.
lines.lose: Well. There go the lads' wages.

secrets.text: Bricks can't be hit while he's singing. He has never tested it sober.
secrets.line: Secret? Bullets hate my singing.

mission.task: Let him sing on the wall: win a Verdance map without losing a tower.

secrets.text: He hears the ground hum an hour before the tanks come.
secrets.line: Ground's humming. Tanks by supper.

secrets.text: He'll share the lads' rations with whoever brings them all home.
secrets.line: Bring my lads home and the rations are yours.

mission.task: Finish a Verdance map with every harvester alive.

secrets.text: He loves Quartermaster Ines Roth, who has never once laughed at his jokes.
secrets.line: Ines nearly smiled at me once. Nearly.

secrets.text: He wants Skyhoney. Enemy honey. Don't ask how he got the taste for it.
secrets.line: Got any Skyhoney? Asking for the lads.

secrets.text: He wants a pub of his own, far from any flag.
secrets.line: One day: a pub, a fire, no flags.

secrets.text: He hates General Kord Stahl, who spends the lads like loose change.
secrets.line: Stahl spends my lads like pocket change.

secrets.text: He won a medal he never wears and hid it in a cannon barrel.
secrets.line: There's a medal in a cannon somewhere. Mine.

mission.task: Find the cannon barrel at the old gun line on Verdance map 5.

secrets.text: He was the only one of his first squad to come home.
secrets.line: First squad. Just me came back.

air.why: He loves Rei "Skylark" Tanaka, an Air ace.

lines.start: I carry the name, not its sins. Show me yours.
lines.win: Well fought. My aunt would call that honest.
lines.lose: Rest. I'll see your dead buried properly.

secrets.text: He wants the house of Halbrecht to end with him, cleanly.
secrets.line: Let the house end with me. Cleanly.

secrets.text: He loves Rei "Skylark" Tanaka, an Air ace, across the war line.
secrets.line: If you meet a pilot called Skylark, tell her I'm alive.

secrets.text: He shot down Rei's wingman before he knew her name.
secrets.line: I shot down her wingman. Before I knew her.

secrets.text: He hates his uncle, General Kord Stahl, for wearing the family colours to a massacre.
secrets.line: My uncle wore our colours to a massacre.

secrets.text: He'll share the Halbrecht war maps with a commander who wins honestly.
secrets.line: Win clean, and the family maps are yours.

mission.task: Win Verdance map 3 at three stars.

secrets.text: He wants Petal Silk, for a scarf he can never give her.
secrets.line: Petal Silk. For a scarf. Don't ask who for.

secrets.text: He knows when Rei is flying overhead. His chest goes tight.
secrets.line: She's up there today. I can feel it.

secrets.text: His mother's signet ring, which proves Kord Stahl is no true heir.
secrets.line: Kord has my mother's ring. It proves everything.

mission.task: Recover the signet ring from Kord Stahl's camp on Verdance map 7.

secrets.text: Bullets turn aside from anyone he swears to protect, once.
secrets.line: I swore to protect you. That counts for one bullet.

mission.task: Win a map without the base taking damage.

artillery.why: He served beside Major Elena Ruiz.

lines.start: Duty brought me here. What brought you?
lines.win: Noted. A promise kept, even by an enemy.
lines.lose: The line holds. It always holds.

secrets.text: He hates deserters more than any enemy.
secrets.line: An enemy I can respect. A deserter, never.

secrets.text: He wants Slag Iron, to recast the regiment's cracked bell.
secrets.line: Slag Iron. The regiment's bell is cracked.

secrets.text: He'll share his regiment's drill with a commander who holds the line.
secrets.line: Hold three maps, and I'll teach you our drill.

mission.task: Win three Verdance maps in a row.

secrets.text: He wakes at the exact minute an attack begins, wherever he is.
secrets.line: I woke at dawn. They're coming.

secrets.text: He wants to be relieved of command. He has asked nine times.
secrets.line: Nine letters asking to be relieved. No answer.

secrets.text: He signed the order that burned Grigor Vosk's village. Vosk doesn't know.
secrets.line: I signed the order that burned Vosk's village.

secrets.text: He loves Major Elena Ruiz of the Artillery. Neither will say it.
secrets.line: Major Ruiz aims wide when I'm on the line.

secrets.text: The regiment's first colours, hidden from the Chancellor.
secrets.line: The first colours are hidden. Help me bring them home.

mission.task: Escort the colours home: win Verdance map 4 without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: His oath binds: a promise he makes cannot be broken by either side.
secrets.line: Make me a promise, and neither of us can break it.

mission.task: Keep three Powder missions without breaking one.

lines.start: Lovely walls. They'll burn so prettily.
lines.lose: Burn it! Burn all of it!

secrets.text: There is no chest. The old ford is where he left his own men to drown.
secrets.line: There's no chest at the ford. Only my men.

lie.text: He says he buried a war chest of gold at the old ford.
lie.line: Gold at the old ford. Dig, friend.

mission.task: Dig at the old ford on Verdance map 5.

secrets.text: He wants Glowcap Spores. He says for lamps. It's for his nerves.
secrets.line: Glowcap. For lamps. Don't look at me like that.

secrets.text: The routes lead into a Freikorps ambush.
secrets.line: The routes? They lead to my knives.

lie.text: He'll share his smuggling routes if you leave the east flank open.
lie.line: Leave the east open. I'll show you the routes.

mission.task: Leave the east flank unbuilt for a whole wave.

secrets.text: He hates Colonel Aldric Vane. He's sure Vane burned his village.
secrets.line: Vane burned my village. I know it.

secrets.text: Fire talks to him. It tells him where it wants to go.
secrets.line: The fire says east. Fire's never wrong.

secrets.text: He wants someone to stop him. Nobody ever has.
secrets.line: Nobody's ever stopped me. Shame.

secrets.text: He loves Drowned Kael like a brother, and would sell him in a heartbeat.
secrets.line: Kael's my brother. I'd sell him for a boat.

secrets.text: He can walk through fire unburned. He leaves before the smoke clears.
secrets.line: Fire doesn't burn me. It knows me.

mission.task: Light the beacons: build four towers before wave 1 ends.

secrets.text: He had a daughter. He doesn't know if she lived.
secrets.line: I had a girl. I never went back.

hightech.why: She respects Grace Sterling, the heir who refused.

lines.start: Present yourself to the line, trespasser.
lines.win: Clean. I mark it with respect, not warmth.
lines.lose: No shame in a line that could not hold. Rest.

secrets.text: She shares the old oaths with anyone who keeps one.
secrets.line: Keep your word to us, and I'll teach you the oaths.

mission.task: Finish a Powder mission without breaking it.

secrets.text: She hates the Chancellor for turning oaths into decrees.
secrets.line: The Chancellor writes decrees. I keep oaths.

secrets.text: She wants an Elder Bloom, for her sister's grave.
secrets.line: An Elder Bloom. For a grave I visit alone.

secrets.text: Her standard never falls while she breathes. Troops near it stand firm.
secrets.line: My standard has never fallen. Neither will I.

mission.task: Hold the line: win Verdance map 6 without losing a wall.

secrets.text: She feels every grave dug in her name, like cold rain.
secrets.line: It's raining graves today. I feel each one.

secrets.text: She loves her nephew Otto, and will not say so while he loves an enemy.
secrets.line: Otto is the best of us. Don't tell him I said so.

secrets.text: She wants Kord Stahl dead, by her own hand. It shames her.
secrets.line: I want Kord dead. By my hand. Forgive me.

secrets.text: The Halbrecht oath-book, hidden in the ruined family chapel.
secrets.line: The oath-book is in the chapel ruins. Bring it back.

mission.task: Recover the oath-book from the chapel ruins on Verdance map 9.

secrets.text: She could not save her sister, Otto's mother, and blames herself, not Kord.
secrets.line: My sister died on my watch. Not Kord's. Mine.

artillery.why: Colonel Hargreave shells whatever he points at.

lines.start: Another grave for the empire. Yours will do.
lines.lose: The empire thanks you for your grave.

secrets.text: He wants Ghost Brass, for the medals he awards himself.
secrets.line: Ghost Brass. A general needs medals.

secrets.text: He pays bounties to anyone who kills for the empire.
secrets.line: Kill for me, and I pay well.

mission.task: Destroy 60 enemies in a single wave.

secrets.text: He hates Otto, who has the name he wanted.
secrets.line: Otto has my name. He doesn't deserve it.

secrets.text: He wants the Halbrecht seat, and Seraphine in the ground.
secrets.line: The seat is mine. Seraphine can have a grave.

lie.text: He claims he wants peace, on the empire's terms.
lie.line: I want peace, Commander. The empire's peace.

secrets.text: Men who fear him fight on past death, for a minute.
secrets.line: My men fear me past dying. A useful minute.

mission.task: Win a map without any wave reaching the base.

secrets.text: He can feel weakness in a room, like a draught.
secrets.line: There's a draught in here. Someone's weak.

secrets.text: The forged papers that made him a general, kept in his boot.
secrets.line: My commission's in my boot. Forged. Satisfied?

mission.task: Take the papers from his camp on Verdance map 7.

secrets.text: He loves Sky-Marshal Reiko Kurogane, the enemy who beat him twice.
secrets.line: Kurogane beat me twice. I think of nothing else.

secrets.text: His father named Seraphine the true heir in front of the whole house.
secrets.line: Father chose her. In front of everyone.

lines.start: Order is coming. Kneel, or be counted.
lines.lose: Balance restored. A hard hand, Commander.

secrets.text: Returned deserters are shot at dawn.
secrets.line: Amnesty? They were shot at dawn.

lie.text: She offers amnesty to any deserter you return to her.
lie.line: Bring me deserters. I forgive, Commander.

mission.task: Return a deserter: finish a Powder mission for her.

secrets.text: She wants a Solar Pearl, for a chain of office cast in her own image.
secrets.line: A Solar Pearl. For the chain of office.

secrets.text: She hates Seraphine, whose oaths outrank her decrees.
secrets.line: Seraphine's oaths are older than my law. For now.

secrets.text: She hears the dead counting under the capital, and it keeps her awake.
secrets.line: The dead are counting again. I hear them.

lie.text: She says she senses nothing. Superstition is for peasants.

secrets.text: Her signature is law. Whatever she writes, people believe.
secrets.line: What I sign becomes true. Sign here.

mission.task: Carry her decree: win Verdance map 8 at three stars.

secrets.text: She wants to replace the Iron Regent.
secrets.line: The Regent is a mask. I could wear it.

secrets.text: She loves the Iron Regent the way a blade loves a hand.
secrets.line: The Regent is the only hand worth serving.

secrets.text: A ledger of every bribe the Assembly ever took, hidden in the treasury.
secrets.line: The Assembly's bribes are in one ledger. Fetch it.

mission.task: Steal the ledger from the treasury on Verdance map 8.

secrets.text: She deserted once. She was never forgiven, so she forgives no one.
secrets.line: I deserted once. Nobody forgave me.

dark.why: It speaks with the Hollow Prophet.

lines.start: Nations are furnaces. You are fuel.
lines.win: The fire banks. It does not go out.

secrets.text: The Regent needs the war. Burning the outpost only feeds it.
secrets.line: End the war? I am the war.

lie.text: The Regent offers to end the war if you burn one Air outpost.
lie.line: Burn one outpost, and the war ends.

mission.task: Win a Verdance map without losing a harvester.

secrets.text: Behind the mask there is no face, only heat.
secrets.line: Lift the mask, and you'll find only heat.

mission.task: Feed the furnace: harvest 40 resources on one map.

secrets.text: It wants a Mycelial Heart, from the Dark Energy's world.
secrets.line: Bring me a Mycelial Heart. It still beats.

secrets.text: It feels every nation's anger as warmth.
secrets.line: So much anger today. How warm it is.

secrets.text: It hates the Chancellor, who thinks she will replace it.
secrets.line: The Chancellor wants my mask. Let her try.

secrets.text: It wants every faction at war at once, forever.
secrets.line: All nine at war. Forever. Imagine the heat.

secrets.text: It loves only the Hollow Prophet, who heard it first.
secrets.line: Only the Prophet heard me. I love it for that.

lie.text: It claims to love the nation like a parent.
lie.line: I love my nation as a parent loves a child.

secrets.text: The first Regent's crown, melted down into the mask.
secrets.line: The crown is in the mask. Earn a look.

mission.task: Win Verdance map 9 at three stars.

secrets.text: It was once the first Halbrecht. It remembers nothing else.
secrets.line: I was a Halbrecht once. That's all I remember.

secondary.name: Mechanic Sora Ito
secondary.line: Tell Ines the gaskets arrived. She'll know.

secondary.name: Corsair Finn Saltmoor
secondary.line: Is Bricks still singing on that wall? He owes me.

secondary.name: Rei "Skylark" Tanaka
secondary.line: Is a captain called Otto down there? Don't answer.

secondary.name: Major Elena Ruiz
secondary.line: Colonel Vane's line? Then I'm aiming wide.

secondary.name: Raider-Chief Drowned Kael
secondary.line: Vosk promised me your gold. I'll take his instead.

secondary.name: Chief Ethicist Dr. Grace Sterling
secondary.line: The Field-Marshal keeps her oaths. Keep yours.

secondary.name: Sky-Marshal Reiko Kurogane
secondary.line: Stahl again? I've beaten him twice. Make it three.

secondary.name: CEO Adrian Sterling
secondary.line: The Chancellor's order is good for business. Don't spoil it.

secondary.name: The Hollow Prophet
secondary.line: The furnace and I are old friends. Listen to it breathe.
